title: A neighbourhood rain-gauge network
paragraphs: A science club built {{1}} inexpensive rain gauge for each of five neighbourhoods. The gauges were placed in open locations {{2}} were away from roofs and tall trees.
{{3}} the students used identical containers, the readings sometimes differed greatly. Each team checked {{4}} gauge at the same time every morning and recorded any unusual conditions.

The club compared the records {{5}} presenting its findings. Members discovered that a single reading could not describe rainfall across the whole town, so they reported the range as well as the average.
